newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see sun, warmer temperatures.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see sun, warmer temperatures.

text.p: Canada's Prairies on Thursday were forecast to see sunny skies and warmer temperatures, Environment Canada said.
There was no frost reported anywhere on the Prairie grainbelt Thursday morning, meteorologist Gerald Machnee said.

Estevan, Sask., was the coldest point on the Prairies at 3.0 Celsius (37.4 F) for three hours while Broadview and Weyburn, also in eastern Saskatchewan, reported 3.0 Celsius for one hour, Machnee said.
Edson, Alta., reported a low of 3.0 Celsius for one hour.
All other points across the Prairies were 5.0 C or warmer.
Alberta should see sunny skies with highs of 23 to 26 C.
Saskatchewan should see mainly sunny skies with highs of 23 to 26 C.
Manitoba should see clearing skies and highs of 14 to 18 C.
